evidence.description: needsUpdate reads the update timestamp directly from User.shared.
save updates the timestamp through the same singleton.

candidates.explanation: News directly reads and updates the application's news-update timestamp through User.shared. This operational dependency is obtained through a singleton rather than an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The state getter reads and sorts items.
After items changes, a main-queue closure reads state and therefore items.
The network completion schedules a write to items on the separate utility dispatch queue.
dispatch is a utility queue, distinct from the main queue used by the state reader.

candidates.explanation: The mutable items collection is written on the utility dispatch queue but read on the main queue through state. The serial utility queue does not synchronize those main-queue reads, and no actor isolation or other synchronization protects the collection across these contexts.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
